senses.definition: To move quickly on foot, usually faster than walking.

examples.text: Ich muss zum Bahnhof rennen, sonst verpasse ich den Zug.
examples.translation: I have to run to the station, otherwise I will miss the train.
examples.emotion: urgent and slightly stressed, watching the time tick away

senses.definition: To participate in a race or competition of speed.
